variants.prompt: Generate ONE standalone tiny mobile UI icon for 拉金盆 meaning pull a gold basin upward. Match the attached approved search icon's B Botanical Line style, rounded sage #55735B outlines with smooth round caps, restrained cream #FFF1DB fill and a TINY butter #FFD778 accent. Strict simple flat geometry, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no highlights, no 3D. Spacious compact near-square icon about 72% of canvas width, transparent RGBA background with generous padding. A shallow WASHBASIN and ONE short upward arrow must read as a single cohesive compact symbol at 32px. Maximum 4 simple visual components. Basin is mostly cream, NOT a large yellow mass. No leaves, no ground line, no shadow ellipse, no motion strokes, no double or triple concentric oval rims, no handles, no ropes, no faces, no text. Outline stroke consistent approximately 5% of icon width. The arrow is small, about one-quarter basin width, never a huge filled arrow above a bowl. Design A1: one broad shallow cream basin with simple rounded trapezoid silhouette, ONE thin warm-yellow rim at top, and a SINGLE gently curved sage line to suggest its open mouth, no complete concentric ellipse. A SHORT thin CORAL open-line up arrow is centered just above and touches the rear rim. Use a simple two-stroke chevron arrowhead and short stem; no outline around the coral arrow. Arrow height only 25% of basin height. Basin broad and low. Total silhouette compact.
